findings.title: Missing User-Stated vs Suggestions Separation
findings.requirement: Requirement 4: Separate user-stated from assistant suggestions
findings.expected: Draft card should show 'You said:' section with userStated array and 'Suggested:' section with assistantSuggestions array
findings.actual: Draft card shows only merged fields (campaignTitle, objective, contentType, etc.) with no attribution of what user explicitly stated vs what AI inferred
findings.consequence: Users cannot distinguish their explicit requirements from AI inferences, violating transparency requirement and reducing trust in the system
findings.evidence: Types define userStated and assistantSuggestions arrays (types/index.ts:255-256) but component lines 941-1040 do not render these arrays
findings.fix: Add UI sections rendering campaignDraft.userStated and campaignDraft.assistantSuggestions as separate labeled lists before or after the editable fields

findings.title: Currency Not Preserved (INR/Amounts)
findings.expected: Draft card should show currency dropdown (INR/USD/etc), preserve user's currency choice, and pass to brief builder
findings.actual: Brief type has no currency field, draft card shows only budgetMin/budgetMax number inputs without currency selector
findings.consequence: User says '15000 rupees' but currency information is lost between voice capture and brief creation, may default incorrectly to USD causing 100x budget error
findings.evidence: Brief interface (types/index.ts:150-175) has budgetMin/budgetMax but no currency field; draft card (lines 999-1018) has number inputs only; system prompt (app/api/director/chat/route.ts:121) says 'Preserve currency (INR if mentioned, USD default)' but no field to preserve it in
findings.fix: Add currency field to Brief type and CampaignDraft, add currency dropdown in draft card UI, update brief builder to handle currency field, OR document that system is USD-only with INR->USD conversion

findings.title: Contrast Improvement Not Applied
findings.requirement: Requirement 7: Improve the current panel's muted text contrast
findings.expected: Muted text should use gray-300 minimum for WCAG AA compliance (4.5:1 contrast ratio)
findings.actual: Code still uses text-muted-foreground and text-gray-400 classes; verification report claims 'gray-300 minimum (was gray-500)' but code does not explicitly use gray-300
findings.consequence: If muted-foreground resolves to gray-500 or lighter, contrast ratio may fail WCAG AA (4.5:1), reducing readability for users with vision impairments
findings.evidence: Line 748: text-muted-foreground/90; Line 863: text-gray-400; Line 1182: text-muted-foreground; Line 1187: text-muted-foreground/70; Verification report line 'Gray-300 minimum (was gray-500)' contradicts actual code
findings.fix: Replace text-muted-foreground with text-gray-300 for body text (lines 748, 1182, 1187) OR verify that theme's muted-foreground CSS variable is set to gray-300 and update verification report to document actual resolved value
